name: Astro Burgers (Draper / South Jordan / Midvale) Charbroiled Chicken Breast on Bun or Plain Cheeseburger
whyItWorks: A local Utah drive-thru institution with locations in both Draper and South Jordan; their charbroiled skinless chicken breast sandwich on a soft sesame-free/lightly-toasted bun or warm Greek pita (no raw onions/tomatoes) is lean and cooked to order.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Charbroiled Chicken Breast Sandwich or a Single Cheeseburger with American/Swiss cheese only—ask for no raw onion, no lettuce, no tomato, and fry sauce on the side.
watchOuts: Skip the Pastrami Burger, deep-fried zucchini/mushrooms, and raw Greek salad during sensitive periods
